mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_moderation_record ( target_type, target_id, provider, decision, risk_level, labels, reject_reason, raw_response, content_fingerprint, task_status, retry_count, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{provider}, #{decision}, #{riskLevel}, #{labels}, #{rejectReason}, #{rawResponse}, #{contentFingerprint}, #{taskStatus}, #{retryCount}, NOW(), NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE decision = VALUES(decision), risk_level = VALUES(risk_level), labels = VALUES(labels), reject_reason = VALUES(reject_reason), raw_response = VALUES(raw_response), content_fingerprint = VALUES(content_fingerprint), task_status = VALUES(task_status), retry_count = VALUES(retry_count), update_time = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM tb_moderation_record WHERE target_type = #{targetType} AND target_id = #{targetId} ORDER BY update_time DESC LIMIT 1
